paragraphs: “Danger ahead!” The fox’s warning reaches Dre’Kaar and Narion through their bracelets. Narion looks for a safer route while Dre’Kaar and the others get ready to defend themselves. Before Narion can lead them away, branches snap on both sides of the trail and enemies rush out from behind the trees.

paragraphs.text: “There’s an enemy behind you!” Faelina warns.
“We need shelter! Does anyone know where to go?” Narion shouts.

paragraphs: Their voices drown one another out. In the confusion, nobody can tell who’s speaking to whom or what they’re asking for.
Elvir casts a spell. Raven rises into the sky and forms a mental link with each companion. Now they can ask Raven for help in their minds without shouting over the noise.
Raven sends each request to the companion who can act on it. He asks Narion to provide cover. When Faelina asks for shelter, he passes the request to Saerenn, who knows where to lead the group.
caption: Many requests → one coordinator
task: Build a class diagram where companions ask through a Mediator interface. Let RavenMediator decide who responds.
